# NextGen Furniture, Inc.

> > Commercial and educational furniture supplier specializing in classroom furniture, office solutions, and outdoor equipment with GREENGUARD Gold and MAS Certified Green products.

NextGen Furniture offers a comprehensive catalog of institutional-grade furniture including adjustable-height desks like the AlphaBetter series, commercial seating, storage solutions, presentation equipment, and outdoor receptacles. Products emphasize durability, ergonomic design, and environmental certifications for schools, offices, and commercial spaces.

## Key Topics

- AlphaBetter adjustable-height desks
- GREENGUARD Gold certification
- MAS Certified Green
- ANSI/BIFMA standards
- Classroom furniture
- Office furniture
- Stand-up desks
- Active learning furniture
- Evos Series outdoor receptacles
- Commercial seating
- Student furniture
- Ergonomic design
- Steel construction
- Plywood furniture
- Free shipping products
